summary: Muscle Gainer v3 backend cap-skip behaviour fully verified: 10/10 pytest tests passed against the live preview backend. Confirmed (a) 'I want to gain muscle' bypasses the 3/day cap (5 consecutive calls -> 5x 200), (b) 'I want to sweat' still enforces the cap (4th call -> 429), (c) the MG bypass is per-user-per-mood (after Sweat hits 429, MG still returns 200), (d) regression check on Lazy/Outdoor/Calisthenics/Explosive moods passes, (e) auth is still required (403 without token), (f) /choose-for-me/usage endpoint shape intact. Frontend code review confirms v3 algorithm wiring in /app/frontend/utils/workoutGenerator.ts (CART_FLAVORS map with badge+subtitle for all 8 cart types) and GeneratedWorkoutView.tsx renders the badge via testID='cart-flavor-badge' + the new subtitle. Added testID='cart-subtitle' for future automated verification. CRITICAL FINDING (out of scope but blocking real-user testing of this feature in the preview): frontend EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL points at https://mood-build.preview.emergentagent.com which currently returns 404 on /api/* — the working backend is at https://mood-cutover.preview.emergentagent.com (matches EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL). End-to-end UI Build-for-Me flow cannot be exercised in this preview until that is reconciled. Deprecated packages detected: expo-av (warned in expo logs).

rca_of_issue: Frontend EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL=https://mood-build.preview.emergentagent.com hits a Cloudflare edge that responds 404 on every /api/* path (verified by curl + browser console). Backend is healthy at https://mood-cutover.preview.emergentagent.com (curl /api/ -> 200, /api/health -> 200). Most likely cause: the App Store cutover renamed the preview deployment hostname from mood-build to mood-cutover but the frontend env was only partially updated (EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL points at mood-cutover, but EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL which is what api/config.ts actually reads still references mood-build). Mitigation: set EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL=https://mood-cutover.preview.emergentagent.com in /app/frontend/.env and `sudo supervisorctl restart expo`. Note: backend functionality itself is unaffected and the v3 cap-skip logic is correct as designed.
